name: Tomida Matsuo
source:
Lawrence "Moe" Curls is a circus clown and ringmaster at Berry Big Circus. A long-time friend of the Berry Big Circus ringmaster Russell Berry, Moe has been part of the Berry Big Circus since it opened in roughly 1997.

Moe is a classic example of a man hiding his sadness behind laughter. At first, he seems to be a happy and immature man who constantly makes bad jokes. However, he quickly becomes sad at the mention of his daughter, Larina, who lives with his estranged wife and so he doesn't see her often. He also suddenly becomes serious if the ringmaster comes up in conversation. Moe takes his job as a clown very seriously. He practices falling down 100 times every night to perfect his breakfall after slipping on a banana peel and his desk is crammed full of joke and clown books, which he claims to spend every free moment studying or reading.

[SPOILER]
He took over the ringmaster's position after the murder of the previous ringmaster, Russell Berry.
[/SPOILER]

[Based on his [URL=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ace_Attorney_Wiki]Ace Attorney Wiki[/URL] page.]
